ActionParams.description:
Player action effects and risks (DEC-073). Time and health costs are in
`tuning.action_costs`; record gains in `career.record_gain`.

late_night_health.description: Health a late-night action costs on top of its own cost.

AiInput.description: Normalised (0..1) inputs the engine computes for an NPC each decision.

oneOf.description: 1 while the NPC is a candidate in an open race.
0 at the start of the campaign, 1 on election eve.
1 for a dead heat (from polls when published, else party strength).
1 − the NPC's mean awareness among the race's voters.
Campaign funds relative to a few weeks of advertising.
Strength of the NPC's view on the most important pending bill.
1 when that bill's vote is on a knife edge.
Appeal of the NPC's best policy idea (own values and constituents).
1 if the NPC has no bill of their own pending.
1 when the council has few bills pending.
Always 1.

top_n.description: Choose by weighted chance among the best `top_n` scores.

AmbientParams.description: Ambient people: generated on demand at places, never stored (DEC-018).

max_listed.description: Most people listed at a place, Named and Ambient together.

period_days.description: Who is around changes every this many days.

present.description: People present at a public place, [min, max].

sway_keep.description: Share of the goodwill already built on a bill that survives an amendment.

AttitudeDef.description:
An attitude dimension (DEC-075): an issue every cohort, politician, and
party holds a position on, in [-1, 1]. Registry order is load order (files
by path, then item order); the engine stores attitudes densely in that order.

key.description:
Short key used in policy signatures, party-name words, and Fluent keys
(`conviction-pro-<key>`, `conviction-anti-<key>`), e.g. `redistribution`.

AttitudeSeed.description:
Starting-opinion model for one attitude. A cohort's position is
`by_class + by_age + by_neighborhood + regional offset + noise`, clamped to
[-1, 1]. Each region draws its own cultural offset once per attitude.

by_class.description: Lean by income class: `[low, middle, high]`.

noise_sd.description: Standard deviation of each cohort's individual variation.

regional_sd.description: Standard deviation of each region's cultural offset.

AudienceDef.description: Who follows an outlet: relative weights by income class and age band.

line.description: Fluent key, with the cast as arguments.

quote_fallback.description:
The speaker quotes their most salient memory of the player in this
line (arguments `memory`, `subject`, `year`); this key is used when
they remember nothing.

oneOf.description: Anyone but the player.

ally_above.description: An ally at or above this opinion; a rival at or below `rival_below`.

BudgetCategory.description: Budget categories (mirror the finance domain's categories).

ad_persuasion_share.description: Persuasion of one ad buy, as a share of one canvass contact's.

ad_saturation.description: Each further ad in a turn is worth this fraction of the last.

contact_memory.description: Share of recent contacts remembered each week (diminishing returns recover).

diminishing.description: Each repeated contact in a neighbourhood is worth this fraction of the last.

npc_contacts_per_week.description: NPC campaign effort in abstracted races (contacts per week per candidate).

npc_effort_base.description: Abstracted NPC effort scales with `npc_effort_base` + oratory.

approval.description: Approval gained per unit of room.

awareness.description: Share of the remaining awareness gap closed.

contact.description: Campaign contact scale (a full day on the doorsteps).

CareerParams.description:
Careers (DEC-011, DEC-076): the record of visible work, the party's
patience, Mandate and viability, name recognition, and election results.

invisible_record.description:
Name recognition kept each month, and while the record is below
`invisible_record`.

loss_viability.description:
After a loss: viability changes by `loss_viability` +
`loss_viability_per_margin` × margin (margin ≥ −0.5), and Standing.

mandate_rate.description:
Mandate: monthly pull toward 50 + `mandate_per_net_approval` × net
approval among the ward's voters.

npc_diligence_rate.description:
NPC officeholders' monthly record gain per unit of diligence, and the
weights of integrity and ambition in diligence.

officeholder_funds.description: Officeholders' yearly war-chest income: base + per unit of oratory.

record_fade.description: Share of every record lost each month.

record_gain.description: Record gained per piece of visible work (the player and NPCs).

scandal_keep_yearly.description: Share of scandal damage kept each year.

thin_record.description:
Party patience: monthly Standing change below a thin record and above
a strong one.

viability_rate.description:
Viability: monthly pull toward a mix of Mandate and Standing (this
share Standing).

win_mandate_base.description:
After a win: Mandate = `win_mandate_base` + `win_mandate_per_margin` ×
margin (at least `win_mandate_min`), and track gains.

Cast.description: How a role is cast from live actors in the player's town.

oneOf.description: The town's power broker (DEC-077 §1).
The player's named rival.
The mayor (when the player is not the mayor).

A Named person with one of these occupations: one with a stake in the
live crisis first, then leaders, then the most influential.
A council colleague (not the player).
Someone the player owes a favour (the largest debt).
A bill before the council.

sponsored_by.description: Sponsored by the person cast in this role.

oneOf.description: The sponsor of the bill cast in `role`.

A neighbourhood of the player's ward: the one least pleased with
the town government (where a crisis bites).

A law of one of these templates in force or being built in town
(`building`: only one still being built).
The person whose goal raised this request (requests only).

The colleague closest to the player (the highest opinion of them):
someone to lean on, or to blame.

discovery_days.description: A hidden fact becomes discoverable within this window after it happened, [from, to] days.

hazard_hold_days.description: A hold on hazards in the player's town lasts this long before it is reviewed.

hazard_max_defer_days.description: A held hazard strikes at most this many days after it was drawn.

recession_hold_months.description: The onset of a global recession may be held at most this many months.

CharacterGenParams.description: Generation of characters (DEC-031): personality and competency ranges.

drift_sd.description: Lazy yearly updates of Named characters: value drift (SD per year).

family_chance.description: Chance a Named character is family of a local politician.

first_impression_sd.description: A Named character's first impression of the player: normal, this SD.

personality.description: Personality axes are drawn uniformly in this range, plus offsets.

trust_initial.description: Trust in someone they have no history with (0..1).

values_sd.description: Named characters' values: their home cohort's view plus noise of this SD.

CharacterParams.description: Characters, memory, relationships, and town character (DEC-031, DEC-077).

CommunityDef.description:
A community (DEC-075): a cohort dimension beside age band and income
class. Every neighbourhood holds age × class cohorts for each community.
Registry order is load order (files by path, then item order). The base
pack ships one community, so the dimension costs nothing until an
expansion adds another (an Indigenous nation, an immigrant community, a
linguistic minority).

attitude_offsets.description:
Added to the seeded attitudes of this community's cohorts, by attitude
key (omitted = 0).

immigration_share.description:
Fraction of international immigrants who join this community (the
remainder community takes whatever the others leave).

share.description:
How much of each neighbourhood's population belongs to this community.
Exactly one community omits it: that community takes the remainder
(in the base pack, `community.general` is everyone).

turnout_offset.description: Added to the seeded turnout propensity of this community's cohorts.

CommunityShare.description:
Share model for a community: in a neighbourhood the community's share of
every age × class group is `base + by_neighborhood[kind] + regional
offset`, clamped to [0, 1]. Each region draws its offset once (sd
`regional_sd`). Where the communities with a share model add up to more
than 1, they are scaled down to 1; the remainder community takes the rest.

base.description: Share everywhere, before the neighbourhood and regional terms.

by_neighborhood.description: Added by neighbourhood kind (omitted kinds are 0).

regional_sd.description: Standard deviation of each region's offset (0 = none).

ConcernDef.description:
A voter concern (DEC-078 decision 3): something that worries a town,
read from an indicator, and the issues (attitudes) it makes voters weigh.
Registry order is load order.

attitudes.description:
The attitudes behind the concern, by key. The magnitude is how much a
worried town weighs that issue; the sign is the side worried voters
lean toward (used to rank concerns by neighbourhood).

level.description: How the indicator's value becomes the concern's level.

name_key.description: Fluent key of the concern's name, e.g. `concern-jobs`.

Condition.description: A condition on live state in the player's town. Roles name cast actors.

oneOf.description: The town lives through a crisis of this kind (`crises.jsonc`).
The town lives through any crisis at least this severe.
An engine indicator of the town, within [min, max].
The concern is among the town's top `top` priorities.
The town's defining industry has one of these drivers.
The player's next local election is within this many days.
The player is (or is not) standing in a running campaign.
The player holds this office.
A track within [min, max].
The player's campaign funds within [min, max] (currency units).
The role's opinion of the player within [min, max] (−100..100).
The player owes the role a favour (or, `owed_to_player`, the reverse).
The role remembers the player doing one of these (memory kinds).
A personality axis of the role within [min, max] (0..1).
The role has one of these traits.

A law of one of these templates is in force or being built in town
(`absent`: none is).

The player's party line on the bill in `role` runs against the mood of
the player's ward.
The player can still declare a vote on the bill in `role`.
The role holds this goal (DEC-032).
At least this many months since play began.
One seat per generated ward / district.
The whole jurisdiction.

param.description: The parameter the per-unit costs multiply.

per_capita.description: Fixed annual cost per resident (price level 1).

per_capita_per_unit.description: Annual cost per resident per parameter unit.

per_unit.description: Annual cost per parameter unit (e.g. per dwelling).

CouncilParams.description:
How council members lean on bills, how mayors sign, and lobbying odds
(DEC-026, DEC-071 §7). Shared by the player and NPCs.

enactment_awareness.description: Public awareness a bill gains at enactment, and the share it loses each month.

mayor_own.description: The mayor's lean on a bill: own values and the town's support.

noise_sd.description: Standard deviation of each member's idiosyncrasy per bill.

own_values.description:
A member's lean: own values (weighted by 1 − pragmatism), the ward's
support (by pragmatism), and the mayor's lean.

player_opinion.description: Goodwill toward the player as sponsor, per 100 points of opinion.

same_party.description: Party discipline: the sponsor's party, and a rival party.

sign_bias.description: Mayors sign unless their lean is below −`sign_bias`.

sunset.description:
Riders: a sunset, a pilot, each other ward's earmark, and an earmark
for the member's own ward.

vote_sharpness.description: Logistic slope from a lean to the chance of a yes vote.

sponsor_yes.description:
The sponsor's opinion of the player: a yes, a no, and a no while they
are owed a favour.

standing_loyal.description: Standing for voting with the party line, against it, and abstaining.

ward_reaction.description: Ward approval per unit of alignment × (0.5 + bill awareness) × room.

CoverageParams.description: Story selection, scandal heat, and perception (DEC-034).

heat_end.description: A scandal ends below this heat.

heat_keep.description: Heat kept each week (a scandal fades).

hostility_interest.description: Extra interest per unit of disagreement between an outlet's lean and the subject.

min_score.description: Stories below this score are not run.

newsworthiness.description: Newsworthiness by severity (a scandal at full heat).

regional_access.description: Interest of a regional (nation) outlet in a town affair, × severity weight.

stories_kept.description: Stories kept (for the newspaper and the audit).

town_news.description: Neutral town news (closures, disasters, laws) the local paper runs.

typical_budget.description: Budget at which an outlet runs its `stories_per_week`.

CrisisDef.description:
A kind of live local crisis (DEC-077 §1), read from an indicator with
hysteresis: it begins at `begin`, ends below `end`, and its severity runs
from 0 at `end` to 1 at `severe`. Registry order is load order and breaks
ties between equally severe crises.

concern.description: The concern it sharpens (a concern id), if any.

policies.description:
Policy templates that answer it: NPC agendas favour them while the
crisis lasts.

Curve.description: Response curve mapping an input (0..1) to a score (0..1).

oneOf.description: m·x + b, clamped to 0..1.
`lo` below `x`, `hi` at or above.

DilemmaCategory.description: The weight of a decision in the director's budgets.

oneOf.description: Only ever a chapter's climax.
A significant decision (may also be chosen as a chapter's climax).
A request raised by an NPC's goal: a lightweight dilemma (minor).

DilemmaDef.description:
A dilemma (DEC-077 §4): a moment where every option costs someone, built
from live state, warned in advance, and explained afterwards.

cooldown_days.description: Days before the same dilemma may be spotlighted again.

opportunity.description:
An opportunity: its arrival is timed by the director rather than
forced by a crisis (DEC-033 B).

raised_by.description:
Raised by a story or an investigation about the player, not by the
spotlight (DEC-006 fairness: never budgeted).

situation_key.description: The situation, with the cast as arguments.

storyline_only.description: Only presented as a storyline stage, never on its own.

DirectorBudgets.description: Decisions and developments allowed per chapter (DEC-033 pacing model).

climax.description: Climaxes per chapter (a campaign chapter's climax is its election).

minor.description: Minor developments (requests, storyline beats, news of the town), [target minimum, maximum].

significant.description: Significant decisions per chapter, [target minimum, maximum].

DirectorParams.description: The narrative director (DEC-033): one file across all packs.

crisis_cap.description:
Crises the player's town may carry before the director holds
exogenous hazards back (the cap on simultaneous unresolved crises).

deadline_days.description: Days to decide when a dilemma gives none.

default_profile.description: Storyteller profile of new games (a `storytellers` id).

development_spacing_days.description: Least days between two minor developments.

history.description: Resolved decisions kept for the story so far.

min_relevance.description: Least relevance for a situation to be spotlighted.

repeat_penalty.description: Score multiplier for a template or a person already spotlighted this chapter.

session_min_days.description:
A session chapter (a budget year in office) lasts at least this many
days; a shorter one runs on to the following year.

spacing_days.description: Least days between two spotlighted decisions.

Discoverer.description: Who may uncover a hidden fact.

oneOf.description: A reporter at an outlet in the subject's town (Named journalists and editors).
A political opponent: the subject's rival.
The town's auditors (money trails).
Police and prosecutors' investigators.

DiscoveryParams.description:
Discovery of hidden facts (DEC-034): whether a fact will come out is
settled when it happens (evidence × interest × access), never by the
director; when, within its evidence window, is the director's (DEC-033 B).

bands.description: Risk bands: low below [0], real below [1], high from [1].

horizon_days.description: The risk line's horizon (DEC-073: "within a year").

journalist_floor.description: Journalist access without any journalist in town (the regional press).

journalists_full.description: A town's journalists add access up to this many (a town without a paper has little).

window_strong.description: Evidence window (days after the act) at evidence 1 and evidence 0.

base_dwelling_price.description: Average dwelling price at price level 1.0.

birth_rate.description: Births per adult aged 18–44 per year.

commodity_volatility.description: Monthly volatility of commodity prices (log scale).

migration_rate.description: Monthly share of mobile adults who reconsider where they live.

recession_depth.description: Peak fall in global demand during a recession, [min, max].

recession_monthly_chance.description: Monthly probability that a global recession begins.

tech_growth.description:
Annual structural trends of a world without a scenario bias:
technology growth, and the drift of manufacturing competitiveness.

unemployment_replacement.description: Unemployment benefit and pension as a share of the mean wage.

EffectDef.description:
One real engine effect of choosing an option (DEC-073: costs and benefits
are simulated, not narrated).

oneOf.description:
The role's opinion of the player changes (scaled by their personality,
as every opinion change is), remembered as `memory` if given.

Approval of the player among voters (−1..1 scale), by income class
(0 low, 1 middle, 2 high; empty = all), in the ward or the town, or in
the neighbourhood cast in `neighborhood`.
Name recognition among voters.
Campaign funds (currency units; negative is a cost).
Time this turn (an option that needs more time than is left cannot be chosen).
Visible work in office (0..1 scale).
A favour: the player owes the role one (or, `owed_to_player`, the reverse).
The player repays a favour owed to the role (a kept promise).

The player declares a vote on the bill in `role` (the council-vote
rules apply: party, ward, and sponsor react).

The bill in `role` gains a rider: a ward project for the player's
ward, or a sunset (its sponsor agrees, or it is the player's bill).
The council-vote rules price it (other wards' members grate at a
ward project; a sunset makes passage easier and the law temporary).

ward_of.description:
A ward project for the ward of the councillor cast in this role
(the vote it buys); the player's ward without one.

oneOf.description:
The role repays a favour they owe the player by backing the player's
side of the bill in `bill` (their lean moves as a traded favour does).

The player drafts a bill of this template (parameters not given take
their defaults).

A borderline or illegal act (DEC-034): a hidden fact that may come to
light (its risk is shown before the player commits, DEC-073).

with_role.description: A cast person in on it (named in the fact).

oneOf.description: The player's answer to a story about them (scandal decisions only).

The player's answer to an investigation (investigation decisions
only); `blame` names the cast ally in `role`.

cycle_offset.description: Elections fall in years where `year % term_years == cycle_offset`.

partisan_ballot.description: Party labels appear on the ballot (otherwise a nonpartisan race).

ElectionTiming.description: Whether a tier votes on the same day as a higher tier (DEC-071: turnout).

rent_growth.description: Per point of real rent growth (a year).

services.description: Per unit of service improvement from laws in effect.

unemployment.description: Per point of local unemployment rise beyond the national rise (a year).

FairnessParams.description:
Fairness (DEC-006): a warning before any terminal ending. A track at or
past its threshold is warned about (pinned event, the pocket's alerts).

legal_jeopardy.description: Warn at or above these (100 is the terminal end).

repeat_days.description: Repeat a warning while the track stays in danger after this many days.

response_days.description: An ending may follow a warning only after this many days (a chance to respond).

standing.description: Warn at or below these (0 is the terminal end of each track).

donor_ties.description: Approval lost among low-income voters, per unit of awareness.

raised.description: Money raised: uniform in [min, max] × (0.5 + oratory). NPCs too.

standing.description: Standing gained (the party likes a fundraiser).

GoalDef.description: An NPC goal template (DEC-032): emerges from circumstances plus personality.

conditions.description: Conditions on the town and the holder (role `holder`).

max_days.description: A goal is given up after this many days (or when its conditions fail).

personality.description: Personality axes of the holder within [min, max].

request.description: When the goal needs the player: a request (a dilemma of category `request`).

traits.description: The holder has one of these traits (empty = no requirement).

GoalDrive.description: How a goal drives the NPC AI (DEC-030 utility AI; the same rules as the player).

oneOf.description: No AI change: the goal only surfaces as a request.

Leans against the player's bills (added to their council lean) and
lobbies against them.
Leans toward the player's bills.

Ranks bills that answer the town's live crisis higher (added to the
agenda bonus, like `npc.crisis_agenda`).

occupations.description: Named people with one of these occupations.

officeholders.description: Council members and the mayor (not the player).

Gravity.description:
How serious a hidden fact is (DEC-006 Legal Jeopardy): a lapse of
ethics, misconduct in office, or a crime.

HeardCondition.description: A fact a line needs. Each names the Fluent arguments it provides.

oneOf.description: The town (or neighbourhood) has this water.
No water at all: no river, no coast, no waterfront.
A live crisis in the town (of this kind, if given): `$crisis_key`.

A plant closed in the town within this many months: `$industry_key`
(the closed plant's sector), `$jobs`.
A disaster struck the town within this many months.
The town has a defining industry: `$industry_key`.
The town has a power broker: `$broker`.
The player has a named rival: `$rival`.

The player's name recognition in the neighbourhood within [min, max]
(0..1): `$player`.

Approval of the player among neighbourhood residents (−1..1), within
[min, max]; only where at least a fifth know them: `$player`.
The rival's record of visible work within [min, max] (0..1): `$rival`.

A scandal running in the town (DEC-034) about this subject:
`$subject` (their name), `$fact_key`.

A story about the town within the last eight weeks: `$outlet_key`
(with `$place`), `$headline_key`, and the headline's own arguments.
The player's next local election is within this many days.
Any one of these holds (the first that does gives the arguments).

HeardSubject.description: Whose scandal a line is about.

HiddenSpec.description:
A borderline or illegal act: what it is, how serious, how much evidence
it leaves, and who might uncover it (DEC-034, DEC-073: the risk is shown
before the player commits).

discoverers.description: Who could uncover it (empty = every discoverer).

evidence.description: How much evidence it leaves (0..1): a paper trail is high, a quiet word low.

Indicator.description:
Engine-provided measures of a municipality, recomputed monthly. Concerns
read them; situational policies (DEC-077) will use them as unlock
conditions. Adding one is a code extension point (one variant, one
computation in `mandate_sim::concerns::indicator`, and a test).

oneOf.description: Unemployment rate (0..1).
Change in the unemployment rate over the last year (points, 0..1 scale).
Annual rent of an average home as a share of a typical (middle-class) income.
The region's pollution index (0 clean, about 0.2 at start, up to 3).
Annual property tax on an average home as a share of a typical income.
The town's debt as a share of its annual budget.
1 just after a disaster, fading to 0 over two years.

Share of the town's jobs lost over the last year (0 when jobs grew):
a plant closure or a failing industry.

awareness.description: Public awareness of a bill when it is introduced (player and NPCs).

JusticeParams.description: The legal path (DEC-006 Legal Jeopardy): investigation, charges, trial, sentence.

charge.description: Chance of charges at the end, × (evidence + `charge_evidence_base`).

convict_base.description: Conviction: logistic(base + evidence × evidence − lawyer + mood × (0.5 − approval)).

disqualify.description: Chance a crime conviction disqualifies from office.

fine.description:
Sentences: a fine (currency, by severity), removal from office
(chance for misconduct; always for prison), prison years for crimes.

fine_standing.description: Standing and viability lost to a fine or a removal.

long_years.description: A sentence this long (years) or a disqualification ends a career.

official_bonus.description: Extra when auditors or investigators found it.

open.description: Prosecutors' interest: chance an investigation opens, × evidence.

open_days.description: Days from discovery to the decision to investigate, [min, max].

release_standing.description: Out of prison: Standing and viability set to at most these.

track_decay.description: Legal Jeopardy falls this much a month with no open case.

track_investigation.description: Legal Jeopardy floors by stage (the track shows the case).

trial_days.description: Days from charges to trial, [min, max] (at least the fairness response time).

LegalResponseKind.description: How the player answers an investigation (DEC-006 Legal Jeopardy).

oneOf.description: Wait and see.

LegalResponseParams.description: Responses to an investigation (the player's decision, NPCs by personality).

blame_charge.description: Blaming an ally: the charge chance × this; the ally's scandal valence + this.

cooperate_charge.description: Cooperating: the charge chance × this, evidence + this, sentence × this.

lawyer_charge.description: A lawyer: the charge chance − this, the conviction logit − this.

stonewall_strong.description:
Stonewalling: at evidence ≥ `stonewall_strong` the charge chance + this
(obstruction), below it − `stonewall_relief`.

LobbyEffects.description: The player's lobbying (the odds and the sway gained are in `council.lobby`).

late_night_legal.description: Legal jeopardy of a late-night deal.

opinion_success.description: The target's opinion of the player after a success and a failure.

trade_gain.description: Sway bought by trading a favour.

LobbyParams.description: Lobbying odds and sway (player and NPCs alike).

gain.description: Sway gained on success: uniform in [min, max] × (0.5 + negotiation).

integrity.description: Personality (DEC-031): − this × (target's integrity − 0.5) in the logit.

opinion_scale.description: Ties with the player: the target's opinion of them divided by this.

same_party.description: Ties between NPCs: the same party, or not.

skill_scale.description:
Logit of success: `skill_scale` × (skill − 0.5) + `pragmatism` × the
target's pragmatism + `bias` + ties (+ `late_night`).

MechanismDef.description:
Typed mechanism primitives (DEC-024). Policies never write outcomes
directly; the domain models compute consequences from these.

oneOf.description: Raise a service level; `per_unit` = index gain per parameter unit.
Annual cash transfer per adult in a class, in currency at price level 1.
Extra dwellings built per year.
Multiplies private housing starts by (1 + per_unit × param).
Subsidy as a share of a sector's wage bill; jobs respond with `elasticity`.

sector.description: Content key of the sector, e.g. `sector.retail`.

oneOf.description: Wage floor as a share above the low-class market wage.
Reduces damage from a hazard by `per_unit` × param (capped at 0.9).
Changes the local property tax by `param` percentage points of value.

MediaParams.description: The media parameter block (one file across all packs).

late_night_deal.description: Late-night deals and fundraising (M5c's hidden facts).

npc_acts.description: NPC acts by id (a `shady_actions` key, or `donor_deal`), with their payoff in funds.

forget_below.description:
A memory whose salience falls below this has faded into the
relationship baseline and is forgotten.

principal.description: Memories kept per Principal and per Named character.

decay.description: Fading per year (salience × e^(−decay × years)); near 0 persists.

magnitude.description: How much it mattered (0..1): its salience when fresh.

opinion.description:
Opinion change (−100..100) when the engine does not set one itself
(the player's actions take theirs from `actions.jsonc`).

sentiment.description: How the holder felt about it (−1..1).

words.description: Optional whole-word list mixed in with generated names.

NeighborhoodLean.description: A value per neighbourhood kind (omitted kinds are 0).

NpcParams.description: NPC AI balance numbers (DEC-030). Scores and curves are in `politics.ai`.

bill_interval_days.description: At most one bill of one's own in this many days.

bill_sunset_years.description: NPC bills sunset after this many years, [min, max].

busy_pending.description: The council is busy at this many pending bills, or this many laws in force.

close_margin.description: A race is a dead heat at 0 and not close at this poll margin.

crisis_agenda.description:
Agendas follow the town's character (DEC-077 §1): ranking its ideas, an
NPC adds this × severity to a template that answers the live crisis,
and `concern_agenda` × fit to one that addresses the town's concerns
(alignment with the concerns' attitudes, weighted by their levels).
The bonus changes which idea comes first, not how keen it is.

funds_in_ads.description: Funds count as full at this many ad buys.

ideologue_below.description:
Strategic profile from traits: an ideologue below this pragmatism,
else a populist above this ambition, else a pragmatist.

insurance_votes.description:
Whip counts: yes votes of insurance wanted beyond the threshold, the
gap at which a count stops being close, and the weight of a count
already on the right side.

lobby_closeness_keep.description:
Planning within a turn: closeness kept after lobbying, and the unknown
share kept after a contact.

two_ads_above.description:
Ads: two buys above this ad score, one above this, and the reserve
(in ad costs) a candidate keeps.

OccupationDef.description:
An occupation or role of Named characters (DEC-018): shopkeepers,
organisers, journalists, clergy, union stewards. Registry order is load order.

ambient.description: Passers-by (Ambient people) may have this occupation.

chance.description: Chance that one such person is generated per place (or neighbourhood).

class.description: Weights of the income classes they come from: [low, middle, high].

expertise.description: The issue they know best (an attitude key); random when omitted.

influence.description: How much weight a leader carries in town (0..1; power broker choice).

leader.description:
Organisation leaders (stewards, editors, chairs) are Principal
characters and can be a town's power broker.

places.description:
Place kinds where they work and can be met (or `streets`, one per
neighbourhood).

OccupationStake.description:
What an occupation has a stake in: the power broker of a town is the
leader with the biggest stake in its defining industry or live crisis.

crises.description: Crisis kinds (content ids) the occupation is drawn into.

drivers.description: Sector drivers (`industrial`, `extraction`, …) the occupation speaks for.

OfficeRole.description: The office a condition asks the player to hold.

oneOf.description: Either.
Out of office.

OpinionParams.description:
Monthly opinion dynamics (DEC-025): experienced conditions and reactions
to laws and bills move approval of the local government and the player.

experience.description: What residents experience, in approval units (tanh scale).

gov_approval_rate.description: Monthly pull of government approval toward its target.

law_reaction_weight.description: Weight of reactions to laws in government approval, beside experience.

player_approval_rate.description: Monthly pull of approval of the player toward reactions to their bills.

player_reaction_scale.description: Sharpness of reactions to the player's bills.

policy_reaction.description: Weight of a bill or law's anticipated reaction per unit of awareness.

aftermath_key.description: What happened and why, after the choice (with the cast as arguments).

default.description:
What happens when the deadline passes without an answer (exactly one
option per dilemma; usually the costly one).

OutletDef.description:
An outlet template (DEC-034): generated per town, region, or nation when
play begins.

finances.description: Yearly budget (currency), drawn in [min, max]: capacity and digging.

interests.description: Concerns it cares about (extra interest in stories that touch them).

journalists.description: Occupations of its journalists (Named people at its home place).

lean_sd.description: Spread of its editorial lean around its audience's views (per issue).

name_key.description:
Fluent key of the outlet's name (`$outlet_place`: its home place's
name for a town outlet, its region's name for a regional one).

place.description: A town outlet's home place kind (DEC-079): towns without one have none.

reach.description: Share of the scope's adults it reaches (an audience weight of 1).

social.description: A social platform: high reach, low credibility, spreads rumours.

stories_per_week.description: Stories it runs a week at a typical budget.

oneOf.description: One per town with its home place (`place`).
One per region.
One for the nation.

OverheardDef.description:
One thing residents may be heard saying at a diner, market, or union hall
(the "overheard" service). Each week every such place draws a few lines
that hold for its neighbourhood: lines about the neighbourhood's top
concerns, and opinions and news grounded in facts. Registry order is
load order. Fluent arguments always include `$town` and `$hood`; each
condition adds its own (see `HeardCondition`).

concern.description:
Heard only where this concern is among the neighbourhood's top three
(a concern id); the stronger the concern, the likelier the line.

weight.description: Relative chance among the lines that hold (default 1).

unit_key.description: Fluent key for the unit label.

attached_by_age.description: Share of adults attached to any party, by age band (young → old).

governing_credit.description:
Credit or blame for the party running the town hall: attachment to it
scales by 1 + (approval − 0.5) × this.

mover_rate.description: Yearly pull of the mover share toward current evaluations.

sharpness.description: Sharpness of attachment by ideological distance.

PartyNameParts.description: Words for generated party names: an attitude-led adjective plus a noun.

PartyRel.description: Which party a cast colleague belongs to, relative to the player.

PerceptionParams.description:
What coverage does to beliefs (DEC-034 perception, DEC-025: perceived
personal impact as shaped by media).

approval.description: Approval of the subject lost per story × weight × heat × exposure × credibility.

awareness.description: Name recognition per story × exposure (a scandal makes you known).

framing.description: Hostile framing scales the hit by (1 + this × hostility).

legal_story.description: A legal development's story: × this (charges, a conviction), and an acquittal gives back this.

standing.description: The subject's Standing (party) per breaking scandal × weight.

statement.description: Approval per covered statement × framing × exposure × credibility.

valence.description: A politician's scandal valence (0..1) per story × weight × heat × exposure × credibility.

PersonalityAiParams.description:
Personality in opinion changes (DEC-031): the same rules for the player
and NPCs. (Loyalty in votes is `council.loyalty_discipline`; integrity
against lobbying is `council.lobby.integrity`.)

warmth_opinion.description: Opinion gains × (1 + w × (2 × warmth − 1)) of the holder.

PlaceKindDef.description:
One kind of place and what it offers (DEC-079). Worldgen decides which
places exist; this registry supplies their behaviour.

actions.description: Actions offered here (keys from the action list).

fallback.description:
Where this kind's actions and services move in a town (or, for
neighbourhood actions, a neighbourhood) that has no such place.

key.description:
Snake-case place kind, as worldgen names it (e.g. `council_chamber`),
or a pseudo-location (`home`, `streets`).

late_night.description: Actions that may also be taken here late at night (a subset of `actions`).

secondary_keys.description: Fluent keys for at least one secondary effect (REQ-006).

side_effects.description: Simulated downsides (DEC-073): every policy costs something besides money.

signature.description:
Value alignment by attitude key (DEC-025 anticipated channel, DEC-075).
Attitudes left out weigh 0.

unlock.description:
A situational policy (DEC-077 §3): on the table (offered, and
draftable by the player or an NPC) only while this trigger holds in
the town. A bill already drafted or a law already passed stays.
Always available without one.

party_count.description: Parties generated per world under plurality rules (two majors plus minors).

early_multiplier.description: Shared error multiplier at the start of the campaign.

shared_sd.description: Election-wide shared error on election eve (share, 0..1 scale).

contact.description: Campaign contact scale (everywhere in the race), unless there was a gaffe.

gaffe_approval.description: Approval lost to a gaffe, per unit of awareness.

deliberation_days.description: Days between introduction and the first stage (deliberation).

RaisedBy.description:
What raises a decision other than the director's spotlight: a story
about the player, or an investigation of them. Raised decisions are
fairness first (DEC-006): never budgeted.

RelevanceWeights.description: Relevance scoring (DEC-033): what connects a situation to the player.

concern.description: It answers one of the town's top concerns.

crisis.description: × the live crisis's severity, when the situation answers to it.

election.description: The player's seat is up within a year.

memory.description: Per salient memory a cast person holds of the player (up to three).

player.description: A cast person has history with the player (an edge, a favour).

pressure.description: It reads one of the player's pressure tracks.

ward.description: The situation is in the player's ward.

ResponseParams.description: Responses to a story (the player's and NPCs').

ad_heat.description: An ad buy during a scandal keeps this much heat (changing the subject).

apologise_evidence.description: An apology is an admission: prosecutors' evidence rises by this.

counter_hostility.description: A counter-attack turns the outlet that broke it more hostile.

deny_heat.description: Heat kept after a denial when the evidence is weak (below `deny_strong`).

deny_strong.description: Evidence at which a denial unravels: heat × `deny_backfire_heat` and Standing.

statement_heat.description: A covered statement during a scandal keeps this much heat (× sympathy).

RiderKind.description: A rider a decision can attach to a bill.

oneOf.description: A project in the player's ward (costs the town money).
The law expires after four years.

id.description:
Role id, referenced by conditions, effects, and Fluent arguments
(`<id>` is the person's name, `<id>-role` their role key).

correction_chance.description: Weekly chance a credible outlet corrects it (× its credibility).

correction_share.description: Share of the harm a correction undoes.

spread_weeks.description: Weeks a rumour spreads on social platforms.

weight.description: A rumour's weight beside a real scandal of the same severity.

ScandalResponseKind.description: How the player answers a story (DEC-034 player communication).

oneOf.description: Say nothing (the story runs its course).

ScenarioDef.description:
A starting world: biases on world generation (geography, economy, era,
politics). Everything left out is drawn at random, as for a random
country, so a scenario only says what makes it different.

name_key.description: Fluent key of the name shown on the title screen.

class_mix.description: Multipliers on each neighbourhood's income-class mix: `[low, middle, high]`.

endowment.description: Multiplies the structural presence of sectors with a driver (omitted = 1).

ScenarioEra.description: The trends of the age: technology and industry, and the climate's drift.

drying.description: Annual drying of the climate; random when omitted.

storminess.description: Annual growth in storminess; random when omitted.

country_extent.description: Size of the country within the map.

industrial_towns.description: Every town and city (not rural places) has an industrial district.

mountain_strength.description: Strength of mountain ranges (0..1); random when omitted.

population.description: Population multiplier on the world size's population.

sea_sides.description: Sides of the country on the sea (1–3); random when omitted.

temp_south.description: Mean temperature in the south (°C); random when omitted.

attitude_shift.description: Added to every cohort's seeded opinion, by attitude key (omitted = 0).

SceneDef.description: A scene template: a short exchange with a character at a place.

oneOf.description: Where the person in `role` works, else a place of the `fallback` kind.

A place of this kind in town (`streets` = the streets of the cast
neighbourhood or the player's home neighbourhood).

Scope.description: Which voters an approval or awareness effect reaches.

oneOf.description: The player's ward.
The whole town.

base_wage.description: Mean annual wage per worker at price level 1.0 (currency units).

base_weight.description: Relative weight of this sector's base presence in a generic economy.

cyclicality.description: Elasticity of job demand to the global demand cycle.

driver.description: Which coded behaviour this sector follows.

talk_key.description:
Fluent key of the sector as residents name it in talk (a noun phrase
such as "the factories"); the name is used without one.

SectorDriver.description:
Behaviour driver of a sector (DEC-075): the closed set of economic
behaviours implemented in code. Sectors themselves are content; several
sectors may share a driver, and a new driver needs a code change.

oneOf.description: Farming and other land-based output: fertility, crop prices, water.
Mining, energy, timber: commodity prices and finite stocks; plant closures.
Manufacturing: national competitiveness and unit labour costs; plant closures.
Construction: housing starts and public spending.
Retail and local services: household consumption.
Tourism and hospitality: scenery, coasts, disasters.
Knowledge and technology: productivity follows the technology trend.
Public employment: funded by government spending.

ShadyActionDef.description: A shady action at a place (DEC-079): its payoff and the hidden fact it leaves.

SideEffectDef.description:
A simulated downside of a policy (DEC-073). The amount is `per_unit`
times the named parameter (or 1 without one), scaled by implementation
progress, funding, and pilot size like the mechanisms.

oneOf.description:
Disruption while the programme is being built (roadworks, construction):
lowers the town's appeal and residents' approval until complete.

A lasting grievance among a group the policy hurts materially (approval
of the government, and of the sponsor). Negative amounts are relief.

min_age_band.description: Only adults in this age band or older (0 = 18–29 … 3 = 65+).

oneOf.description: Changes how much a class works (share of its labour force).

SituationCondition.description:
A typed condition on one town's live situation, read from engine state
(the town's character, its indicators, the event log, the economy).

oneOf.description: A live crisis of this kind (`crises.jsonc`), at least this severe.
An engine indicator of the town within [min, max].
A plant closed in the town within this many months (the event log).
A disaster struck the town within this many months.

SituationTrigger.description:
A trigger on a town's situation: it holds while any of its conditions
does. Reusable wherever content needs "when this town is in this kind of
situation" (situational policies now; policy families later).

reason_key.description: Fluent key naming the circumstances, e.g. `unlock-closure`.

oneOf.description: A vote of a body under a decision rule.
An office signs or vetoes; a veto may be overridden by a body.

advance.description:
Conditions to reach this stage (checked weekly once the previous
stage is done).

branches.description: Option id → the next stage id (others go to the next stage in order).

decision.description:
The decision presented at this stage (a dilemma whose roles are the
storyline's), if any.

ends.description: The storyline ends at this stage.

key.description: What this stage is, with the cast as arguments (the story so far).

timeout_days.description: The storyline fades if this stage is not reached within this many days.

wait_days.description: Days after the previous stage before this one can be reached.

StorylineDef.description:
A storyline template: roles cast from live actors, stages that advance on
conditions and the player's choices, outcomes written back only through
engine commands (decision options).

cooldown_days.description: Days before the storyline may start again after it ends.

faded_key.description: What the story so far says when a stage times out (the arc fades).

follow_up.description:
A storyline that may start after this one ends, with the same cast
where its roles match (a follow-up hook).

StorytellerDef.description:
A storyteller profile (DEC-033 addendum): a transparent difficulty and
flavour lever over chance and pacing, never over consequences.

budget_scale.description: Multiplies the significant and minor budgets.

defer_hazards.description:
Hold hazards in the player's town while it carries `crisis_cap`
crises. Timing only: a held hazard still strikes, at its drawn severity.

hazard_rate.description:
Share of hazard strikes in the player's town that happen (1 = the
hazard model as drawn).

hold_recessions.description: Hold the onset of a global recession while the player's town is at the cap.

tension_curve.description:
Pace decisions along the chapter's tension curve (otherwise spotlight
whatever is ready, within the budgets).

income.description: Effective income tax by class: low, middle, high (national tier).

property.description: Annual property tax as a share of dwelling value (local tier).

TemptationParams.description: NPCs' temptations (DEC-030: the same acts and the same exposure).

acts.description: What they take: the player's diner bribe, or a donor deal.

chance.description: Chance per turn for an officeholder of integrity 0 (× ambition factor).

TensionParams.description:
The chapter's tension curve: it rises from `start` to `peak` at `peak_at`
(a share of the chapter), then falls to `end`.

catch_up_at.description: From this share of a chapter on, a chapter short of its minimum spotlights whatever is ready.

climax_window.description: The share of a session chapter in which its climax may come, [from, to].

crisis_weight.description: Weights of live tension: the town's worst crisis, pending decisions, the player's race, and track danger.

slack.description: A significant decision is spotlighted while tension is below the curve plus this.

elections.description: When this tier's elections happen (all elected bodies and offices share it).

broker_seniority.description:
Power broker: weight of an officeholder's seniority (per year in
office) against a leader's influence and stake.

broker_stake.description:
Stake weight of a leader whose stake matches the defining industry
or the live crisis.

trend_months.description: Months of crisis severity kept for the trend.

bill_nudge.description:
Approval nudge per unit of alignment with the bill discussed, and
without a bill.

contact_base.description:
Campaign contact: (`contact_base` + `contact_oratory` × oratory), ×
`hostile_contact` when hostile. NPC town halls use the same scale.

hostile_nudge.description: Approval nudge from a hostile crowd.

risk_base.description:
Chance of a hostile crowd: `risk_base` − `risk_approval` × the
player's net approval − `risk_government` × (government approval −
0.5), within [`risk_min`, `risk_max`].

TrackKey.description: A pressure track, record, or Mandate (DEC-006, DEC-011, DEC-076).

oneOf.description: Visible work in office, 0..100.

TraitDef.description:
A character trait tag (DEC-031): a name plus data-driven modifiers.
Characters get 0–3 traits at generation. Registry order is load order.

chance.description: Chance a generated character has this trait (before the three-trait cap).

excludes.description: Traits that cannot be held together with this one.

memory_decay.description:
Multiplies how fast memories fade: good ones (`positive`) and bad
ones (`negative`). A grudge-holder's bad memories fade slowly.

opinion_change.description: Multiplies opinion changes toward others: gains and losses.

personality.description:
Added to personality axes (`ambition`, `integrity`, `warmth`,
`boldness`, `loyalty`), clamped to 0..1.

TraitScale.description: A multiplier pair for good and bad news.

action_costs.description:
Time and health each action costs (DEC-073). Missing actions cost one
slot and no health; negative health is recovery.

burn_in_years.description: Years of NPC-only simulation before the player starts (DEC-022).

late_night_enabled.description: Whether the optional Late Night slot is offered.

standard_slots.description: Standard day-part slots per turn (Morning, Afternoon, Evening).

turn_days.description: Turn lengths in days by phase (DEC-012).

final_stretch.description: Days before an election that switch to daily turns.

habit_base.description:
After an election, each cohort's habit is its neighbourhood's turnout ×
(`habit_base` + `habit_propensity` × its own turnout propensity).

mobilisation_max.description: Extra turnout from a fully mobilised neighbourhood.

standalone.description: Turnout multiplier for a standalone local election.

VoteChoice.description: How the player votes through an option.

oneOf.description: As the player's party expects.
As the player's ward leans.

beta_low.description: Directional share β at low and high polarisation.

challenger_awareness.description: Awareness of a fresh challenger before campaigning.

executive_multiplier.description: Retrospective weight multiplier for executive offices.

governing_party_record.description: Share of the incumbent's record carried by the governing party's new nominee.

incumbent_awareness.description: Awareness floor for an incumbent within their constituency.

independent_viability.description: Local viability of a candidate without a party.

media_base.description: Media attention on a town's record: a base, plus its share of the region's people.

minor_party_threshold.description: Minor parties contest only where their attachment share reaches this.

national_swing_sd.description: National swing per party shared by every race in an election.

partisan_discount.description: Share of retrospective blame partisans forgive their own side.

perceived_own_weight.description:
Perceived position on a partisan ballot: the candidate's own views and
their party's platform, blended with these weights.

player_approval_weight.description: Weight of voters' approval of the player in the player's own races.

player_incumbent_awareness.description:
Starting awareness: the player as incumbent and other sitting
officeholders in town (shares of `incumbent_awareness`), the bonus in a
candidate's home neighbourhood, and the cap.

polarization_low.description: Mean attitude standard deviation mapped to β_low and β_high.

record_penalty.description:
An incumbent's record of visible work (DEC-076). Below the baseline,
opponents campaign on it and every voter hears (`record_penalty` per
point, not discounted by awareness); above it, voters who know the
incumbent reward it a little (`record_bonus`).

renomination_standing.description: Below this Standing the party will not renominate its own officeholder.

retro_economy_weight.description:
Weight of the town's benchmarked economy in retrospection, beside
approval of the local government.

retro_unemployment_scale.description:
Retrospective signal per point of local unemployment change beyond the
national change over a year (clamped to ±1).

salience_base.description:
Issue salience (DEC-078 decision 3): every attitude's raw salience in
a town is this base plus each concern's level × |its weight on the
attitude|; the vector is then scaled to a mean of 1, so the issue
weight keeps its meaning. A larger base mutes local priorities.

strategic_weight.description: Wasted-vote penalty for candidates whose party is weak locally (Duverger).

valence_oratory.description: Valence: weight of oratory and of integrity (each around its midpoint).

WaterFeature.description: Water a town or neighbourhood can have.

oneOf.description: The town is on a river.
The town is on the coast.
A river, the coast, or a waterfront neighbourhood.

description: One content file. The `kind` field selects the variant.

oneOf.description: Pack manifest (exactly one per pack).

load_order.description: Load order: lower first. The base pack is 0.

name_key.description: Fluent key for the pack's display name.

oneOf.description: Tuning parameters (REQ-005).
Economic sectors (DEC-019).
Attitude dimensions: the issues voters hold views on (DEC-025, DEC-075).
Communities: a cohort dimension beside age and class (DEC-075).
Voter concerns: what worries a town, and which issues it makes salient (DEC-078).
Name-generation pools for places and people.
World scenarios: starting worlds as biases on the generator (DEC-078).
Place kinds: what the player can do and learn at each kind of place (DEC-079).
Economy and demography parameters (REQ-005).
A constitutional archetype built from primitives (DEC-017).
Policy templates (DEC-024, DEC-026).
Parties, elections, polls, campaigns, and NPC AI (DEC-027 to DEC-030, DEC-071).
Opinion dynamics: how conditions and laws move approval (DEC-025, DEC-078).
Player action effects and risks (DEC-073, DEC-078).
Council leans, mayoral signatures, and lobbying odds (DEC-026, DEC-078).
Records, Standing, Mandate, and name recognition (DEC-011, DEC-076, DEC-078).
NPC AI balance numbers beside the utility curves in `politics.ai` (DEC-030, DEC-078).
Character trait tags with data-driven modifiers (DEC-031).
Occupations and roles of Named characters (DEC-018, DEC-031).
Kinds of live local crisis a town can have (DEC-077 §1).
Character, memory, relationship, and town-character numbers (DEC-031, DEC-077).
The narrative director's pacing, fairness, and chance numbers (DEC-033).
Storyteller profiles (DEC-033 addendum).
Overheard talk: what residents say at diners, markets, and union halls (DEC-079).
Dilemmas and requests: decisions where every option costs someone (DEC-077 §4).
NPC goal templates (DEC-032).
Storyline templates (DEC-032).
Scene templates: short exchanges at a place (DEC-035, DEC-079).
Outlet templates: newspapers, broadcasters, and social platforms (DEC-034).
Discovery, coverage, perception, responses, rumours, shady acts (DEC-034).
Investigations, charges, trials, and sentences (DEC-006 Legal Jeopardy).

title: ContentFile
